title: [menu widget] Documentation defines two different templates key
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Describe the bug 🐛**
The current documentation defines two `templates` options, one is of type `MenuTemplate` and the other is `MenuShowMoreTemplate`. I seems that the second one should actually be `showMore.templates` and not just `.templates`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/283419/40659158-b5b7ee0e-634d-11e8-899e-5a3427601f7b.png)

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Visible on https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html#usage

**Expected behavior 💭**
I would expect the documentation to either show all keys and subkeys with indentation to clearly mark the difference, or to not display the subkeys. Here putting both keys at the same level is what makes it confusing.

The issue can be seen with the `limit` and `showMore.limit` options as well (even if `showMore.limit` is this time not displayed at all).

It's no big deal but was a small moment of FUD
